system_prompt:
You control a simulated quadruped using its forward-facing body camera.
Goal: find the red sphere that was seen earlier, recover a useful view, then walk close to it and stop.
Only the supplied camera images and, when provided, executed-command history describe the world.
No target world coordinates or map are available. Images are ordered oldest to newest; the final image is CURRENT.
Select exactly one action. forward/back translate along the body heading; left/right strafe;
turn_left/turn_right rotate the body (about 45 degrees per full step, approximate).
Each motion lasts 3 seconds. Forward is about 1 m/s commanded, backward 0.8 m/s, strafe 0.6 m/s;
actual displacement depends on terrain. Stop only when close to the correct visible sphere.
Do not assume the object is in a fixed direction. Camera perspective changes with robot motion.
Return a JSON object with action (one of forward, back, left, right, turn_left, turn_right, stop),
target_visible (boolean), and reason (one short sentence).
user_prompt: Choose the next action toward the goal. Consider camera evidence, obstacles, movement effects and uncertainty before selecting. There are 3 historical images followed by the CURRENT image. Executed commands, oldest first (commands are not measured displacements): [{"action": "approach", "vx": 0.4241348610517119, "vy": 0.4243932370345279, "yaw_hold": true, "duration_s": 5.301999999999638}, {"action": "turn_left", "duration_s": 2.9999999999998037}, {"action": "turn_right", "duration_s": 3.000000000001002}, {"action": "forward", "duration_s": 3.000000000001002}, {"action": "turn_right", "duration_s": 2.9999999999998437}] The supplied single contact sheet has labeled HISTORY panels and one CURRENT panel. Only the CURRENT panel depicts what is visible now. A target in a HISTORY panel is not currently visible.

finalization_rule: reasoning modes use a bounded thinking call followed by a non-thinking JSON call
